_meta.description: Verified catalog of GA Kubernetes features worth ADOPTING once the upgrade target reaches availableInVersion. Consumed by AdoptionSuggestionCatalog for AdoptionSuggestionAnalyzer. This is the radar's only non-breakage tier: every rule pairs a version-gated feature with an inventory predicate showing the cluster still uses the OLD pattern, and a `benefit` sentence saying what the customer gains — findings are always INFO / scoreImpact 0 / enforcementLevel 'suggestion' and can never move the upgrade score.
_meta.verificationMethod: Every availableInVersion below was read directly from the official kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-<version>.md files in a local clone (whole-file grep, not a summarizer). Exact matched sentence is recorded per-rule in `provenance`. NONE of these values were hand-typed from memory.
_meta.predicateNote: predicateKey names a Java predicate registered in AdoptionSuggestionAnalyzer. A rule whose key is unregistered is SKIPPED with a WARN (never a crash, never a silent wrong answer); AdoptionSuggestionCatalogTest asserts the registry covers every key so that path stays theoretical.
_meta.oldAgentNote: Predicates marked fieldPresence=true read presence-gated fields the agent only collects from version 0.4.38+. On an older agent the field is always absent, so the suggestion may fire for a feature the cluster ALREADY adopted — tolerated because the cost is one INFO line, and each such rule's remediation says to upgrade the agent if the feature is already in use.

rules.title: CronJobs can pin an explicit timeZone (GA since 1.27)
rules.benefit: Schedules survive daylight-saving transitions — jobs stop firing an hour early or late twice a year, and the schedule you read is the schedule that runs.
rules.remediation: Set spec.timeZone (e.g. "Europe/Berlin") on each CronJob whose schedule is meant in local time. If these CronJobs already set timeZone, upgrade the runtimez agent so it is visible here.

rules.title: PVCs on ReadWriteOnce could use ReadWriteOncePod (GA since 1.29)
rules.benefit: A hard single-POD guarantee instead of single-node: during node drains and reschedules, two pods can no longer mount the same volume and corrupt it.
rules.remediation: For volumes that must only ever be written by one pod, change the PVC accessMode from ReadWriteOnce to ReadWriteOncePod (requires CSI driver support).

provenance.name: kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-1.29.md
provenance.matchedText: Graduate the `ReadWriteOncePod` feature gate to GA

rules.title: Validating webhooks could migrate to in-process ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (GA since 1.30)
rules.benefit: Admission checks run inside the apiserver as CEL expressions: no webhook network hop (lower latency), no webhook outage that can block or fail-open every admission, and one less deployment + TLS cert to operate.
rules.remediation: Review each ValidatingWebhookConfiguration; policies expressible as CEL over the admitted object can move to ValidatingAdmissionPolicy/Binding. Keep webhooks only for checks needing external data.

provenance.name: kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-1.30.md
provenance.matchedText: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy was promoted to GA and will be `enabled` by default.

rules.title: PDBs can set unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow (GA since 1.31)
rules.benefit: Node drains stop getting stuck behind pods that are already broken — the PDB keeps protecting HEALTHY replicas while unhealthy ones can always be evicted, making cluster upgrades faster and less manual.
rules.remediation: Set spec.unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow on PodDisruptionBudgets. If these PDBs already set it, upgrade the runtimez agent so it is visible here.

provenance.name: kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-1.31.md
provenance.matchedText: The PodDisruptionBudget `spec.unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy` field has graduated to GA. This field may be set to `AlwaysAllow` to always allow unhealthy pods covered by the PodDisruptionBudget to be evicted.

rules.title: Jobs can declare podFailurePolicy (GA since 1.31)
rules.benefit: Non-retriable failures (bad image, OOM-kill, config error) fail the Job immediately instead of burning the full backoffLimit in doomed retries — less wasted compute and the real error surfaces minutes sooner.
rules.remediation: Add spec.podFailurePolicy rules (e.g. FailJob on a non-retriable container exit code, Ignore on disruption) to Jobs and CronJob job templates. If already set, upgrade the runtimez agent so it is visible here.

provenance.name: kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-1.31.md
provenance.matchedText: Graduated `JobPodFailurePolicy` to GA and locked it to it's default.

rules.title: StatefulSets can auto-clean their PVCs via persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy (GA since 1.32)
rules.benefit: PVCs from scaled-down or deleted StatefulSets are deleted automatically instead of accumulating as orphans — stops the silent storage-cost creep that otherwise needs manual PVC audits.
rules.remediation: Set spec.persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy (e.g. whenDeleted: Delete, whenScaled: Retain) on StatefulSets that use volumeClaimTemplates. If already set, upgrade the runtimez agent so it is visible here.

provenance.name: kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-1.32.md
provenance.matchedText: Promoted feature gate `StatefulSetAutoDeletePVC` from beta to stable.

rules.title: Sidecar-style containers can become native sidecars (initContainers with restartPolicy: Always, GA since 1.33)
rules.benefit: Kubernetes finally orders them correctly: the sidecar is up BEFORE the app starts and shuts down AFTER it exits — Jobs stop hanging on a still-running proxy, and startup races against log/metrics shippers disappear.
rules.remediation: Move recognized sidecar containers (proxy/collector/log-shipper images) from spec.containers to spec.initContainers with restartPolicy: Always. Detection uses a curated image list (otel-collector, envoy/istio-proxy, fluent-bit, promtail, cloud-sql-proxy) and will not recognize custom sidecar images.

provenance.name: kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-1.33.md
provenance.matchedText: The `SidecarContainers` feature has graduated to GA.

rules.title: Pod anti-affinity can scope to one rollout via matchLabelKeys (GA since 1.33)
rules.benefit: Spreading stays correct DURING deployments: with matchLabelKeys: [pod-template-hash], old- and new-ReplicaSet pods stop repelling each other, so rollouts no longer stall or land skewed on large clusters.
rules.remediation: Add matchLabelKeys: ["pod-template-hash"] to podAntiAffinity terms on Deployments so the constraint applies per-revision.

provenance.name: kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-1.33.md
provenance.matchedText: Graduate the `MatchLabelKeys` (MismatchLabelKeys) feature in PodAffinity (PodAntiAffinity) to GA

rules.title: Multi-zone Services can keep traffic in-zone via trafficDistribution (GA since 1.35)
rules.benefit: Service traffic prefers same-zone endpoints — measurably lower cross-zone data-transfer cost and lower latency, with automatic fallback to other zones when local endpoints are gone.
rules.remediation: Set spec.trafficDistribution: PreferClose on ClusterIP Services whose clients and endpoints run in every zone. If already set, upgrade the runtimez agent so it is visible here.

rules.title: Restart-sensitive workloads can resize CPU/memory in place (GA since 1.35)
rules.benefit: Right-size requests and limits WITHOUT restarting pods — no availability blip, no connection churn, which makes acting on right-sizing recommendations essentially free for StatefulSets and single-replica services.
rules.remediation: Use the pod resize subresource (kubectl patch --subresource=resize) or set container resizePolicy to tune resources on StatefulSets and single-replica Deployments without a rollout.

rules.title: Workloads could adopt user namespaces — hostUsers: false (UserNamespacesSupport GA since 1.36)
rules.benefit: Containers run as unprivileged host UIDs even when they believe they are root: a container escape lands as a nobody-grade UID on the node, defusing whole classes of breakout CVEs without changing the image.
rules.remediation: Set spec.hostUsers: false on pod templates whose images tolerate UID remapping (most stateless services do). Requires nodes with idmap-mount support (modern kernels + containerd 1.7+/CRI-O 1.25+). Roll out per-workload, starting with internet-facing services. If these workloads already set hostUsers, upgrade the runtimez agent so it is visible here.

provenance.name: kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-1.36.md
provenance.matchedText: Graduated the `UserNamespacesSupport` feature gate to GA.

rules.title: PVCs could use VolumeAttributesClass for in-place volume tuning (GA since 1.36)
rules.benefit: Change a live volume's performance parameters (IOPS, throughput class) by switching its VolumeAttributesClass — no volume recreation, no data migration, no pod restart dance.
rules.remediation: Define VolumeAttributesClass objects for your storage tiers and set spec.volumeAttributesClassName on PVCs that may need retuning (requires CSI driver support — check your driver's release notes). If these PVCs already set volumeAttributesClassName, upgrade the runtimez agent so it is visible here.

provenance.name: kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-1.36.md
provenance.matchedText: Locked the `VolumeAttributesClass` feature gate to `true` and updated the preferred storage version to `storage.k8s.io/v1`.

rules.title: Mutating webhooks could migrate to in-process MutatingAdmissionPolicy (GA since 1.36)
rules.benefit: Mutations run inside the apiserver as CEL: no webhook network hop on every admission, no mutating-webhook outage that can block all matching writes during upgrades, and one less deployment + TLS cert to operate.
rules.remediation: Review each MutatingWebhookConfiguration; label/annotation injection and defaulting expressible as CEL can move to MutatingAdmissionPolicy/Binding (GA v1 in 1.36). Keep webhooks only for mutations needing external data.

provenance.name: kubernetes/kubernetes CHANGELOG-1.36.md
provenance.matchedText: Promoted the `MutatingAdmissionPolicy` to GA (v1) in Kubernetes `v1.36`. The feature is now enabled by default.
